# Source of this fixture

**Synthesized, not recorded off WhatsApp.** Generated by:

    replaygate record whatsapp_support ./fixtures/whatsapp_support --channel whatsapp

which drives `WhatsAppAdapter` against `ScriptedTransport` — a virtual-clock fake of
the Node sidecar. The message ids are `WA-1`/`WA-2`/`WA-3`, not WhatsApp ids, which is
how you can tell at a glance.

It exists so the offline suite, CI, and the dashboard have a WhatsApp run to exercise
without a live number. **S3-T3 replaces it** with a real recording made through
`replaygate record-whatsapp`; after that this file says so instead.

`write_fixture` only writes the six fixture files, so this note survives a re-record.
